source_request.splits: original 800 train / 200 heldout classes, five images per class; all-classes summary also retained
source_request.real: saved raw normalized encoder-clean latent, not reconstruction or pixels
source_request.arithmetic: stored FP16 promoted to FP64; classwise two-pass centering; no covariance matrix
source_request.anova: T=W+m*(C-1)/(m*C-1)*B*; reports contributions to IG-minus-Full trace
source_request.finite_sample_assumption: Within each fixed class the five real images and five generated noises estimate class-conditional moments. Real/generated draws are independent; Full/IG are paired by common noise. Class means themselves may differ arbitrarily across labels.
source_request.pair_geometry: Pairwise squared distances and cross products are recovered exactly from class moments. No fitted scale, whitening, clustering, or feature selection.
limits: Classes are not identified semantic modes; traces do not establish isotropic or Gaussian heat flow.
Exact positive scalar scaling about each unchanged Full class center requires unchanged centroids and collinear within-class pair differences.

Exact contraction of class centroids about a common global center requires collinear centroid-pair differences and reduced centroid-pair scale; preserving class shapes additionally requires unchanged within-class pair differences.
These are retrospective finite-bank necessary-condition diagnostics, not quality/FID or population guarantees.

source_summary.boundary: Conditional moment diagnostic only; five images per class, retrospective banks, no semantic mode identity or heat-flow/quality guarantee.

additional_algebra.definitions: B_F*,B_I* are finite-m-corrected centroid scatter; C_FI*=observed centroid cross-scatter-W_FI/m; B_delta*=B_F*+B_I*-2C_FI*. Corrected corr(centroid Full, centroid delta)=(C_FI*-B_F*)/sqrt(B_F* B_delta*). Within corr(Full,delta)=(W_FI-W_F)/sqrt(W_F W_delta). No scale was fitted.
additional_algebra.boundary: Noise-corrected ratios are finite-bank estimators, not necessarily bounded correlations. Full/IG alignment near one can coexist with a strongly nonradial small displacement.

validation.basis: Class-level sufficient-statistic NPZ plus global-mean norms saved in the source summary; pooled means themselves were not independently recomputed from the full raw arrays during archiving.
validation.raw_latent_content_hash_boundary: The original CPU run hashed every consumed FP16 row; archiving preserves these hashes and checks metadata, but does not reread 14.65 GiB of latent content.

statistical_boundary.sampling: Fixed uniform class coverage; five real observations and five independent generated noises per class. Full and IG are paired through common noise. Real/generated draws are treated as independent conditional on class; no identical class means or independence across coordinates is assumed.
statistical_boundary.unbiasedness_scope: W and the finite-m subtractions have the stated expectation under the class-conditional sampling model. Real source rows were selected without replacement from ImageNet; this is not an exact finite-population mean-risk certificate conditional on the complete realized ImageNet dataset.
statistical_boundary.negative_estimates: Finite-m-corrected scatter and squared distances are never clamped. A negative corrected squared distance has no reported real-valued square root.
statistical_boundary.uncertainty: No new confidence interval or fitted scale. These banks and class splits were reused previously; two-bank agreement is retrospective mechanism evidence, not independent confirmation of a selected guidance method.

decision.supported: Across both banks and original train/heldout splits, pooled variance repair combines increased within-class trace with decreased noise-corrected between-class centroid scatter.
decision.simple_scaling_boundary: Within-class paired-difference alignment is about 0.805. Corrected centroid Full/IG alignment about 0.996 does not establish pure centroid contraction: the centered centroid displacement-versus-Full alignment is about -0.634/-0.622 on the complete banks, rather than -1 required by a single contracting scalar plus common translation.
decision.heat_boundary: The hypothesis that Full differs from the real raw encoder-latent law only by independent additive zero-mean noise is unsupported by the observed Full pooled and within-class underdispersion: such a convolution adds a nonnegative covariance trace. This does not test a Base-only endpoint distribution and does not rule out other class-conditional blur or temperature mechanisms.
decision.quality_boundary: Improved traces do not imply improved centroid accuracy, complete distribution matching or FID. No new FID, guidance candidate, model training, model calls or GPU work was performed.

legacy_metric_reconciliation.old_definition: mean(candidate coordinate variance) / mean(reference coordinate variance), i.e. ratio of traces, not a mean of coordinate-wise ratios.
legacy_metric_reconciliation.old_cohort: Original train mask only, 4000 images / 800 classes. New all-cohort values use all 5000 images; new train values reproduce the old CSV.
legacy_metric_reconciliation.variance_denominator: Old per-coordinate moments use divisor N; new pooled covariance trace uses N-1. Equal N in candidate/reference makes the common factor cancel in their ratio.
legacy_metric_reconciliation.psd_heat_condition: Use covariance trace, not the mean of coordinate-wise variance ratios, for the necessary nonnegative trace increase under independent additive noise.
